# Learned instinct: ansible-molecule-ships-with-role (confidence 0.9)

Every new Ansible role must ship with a Molecule scenario under `molecule/default/` that includes converge.yml, verify.yml, and an idempotence test. The idempotence test runs converge.yml twice and asserts no changes on the second run. Roles without Molecule scenarios are not accepted by the iac-author review gate.

Source: ansible-testing skill; SPEC §4 — test coverage requirements
